artworks.title: Aspect que commencent déja a avoir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows people leaning out of windows on a street. It depicts a building with multiple windows where individuals and anthropomorphic figures are looking out. The style features strong line work, giving the scene a sense of urgency. The gray monochromatic palette highlights the nighttime setting. The surrounding buildings are minimally detailed, emphasizing the interaction between the building's inhabitants and something outside.

artworks.title: Les planètes étant elles-mêmes dans ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three celestial figures seated on clouds with telescopes. The figures are robed and armored, with stars above their heads, observing the sky. They are depicted in a serene atmosphere, one figure on the left in a contemplative pose with a long beard and robe, the middle figure partially reclined, and the figure on the right in armor. The stars above their heads symbolize a connection to the heavens. The drawing uses shading and lines to create depth and detail in the figures and surroundings.

artworks.title: Croyant l'apercevoir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration of two individuals on a bed. One person is sitting upright and the other is lying down. The sitting person has a distinct profile with a prominent nose, jawline, and thin lips, wearing a pointed nightcap. The person's upper body is visible, covered by a long-sleeved nightshirt. The lying person is mostly hidden under the sheets, showing only their head and part of their torso. Both individuals wear pointed nightcaps and have similar facial features. The setting includes a dark backdrop with heavy curtains around the bed frame. Light streams through a window on the left, suggesting a nighttime scene with possible stars. The room appears dimly lit, focusing on the two characters.

artworks.title: Un émule de Mr Hume
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman in full-length positions. The woman is on the left, standing with her body slightly turned towards the man, hands clasped together. She has an expressive open-mouth posture, and her hair is pulled back. She is wearing a long dress with puffed sleeves. The man is also standing, leaning slightly forward towards the woman, with one hand gesturing outward and the other raised slightly. His facial features include a prominent nose and an open mouth. He has untidy hair and is dressed in a tailcoat, waistcoat, and checkered trousers. The surroundings include a decorative piece behind the woman, and the background is sketched with vertical lines.

artworks.title: Mr et Mme Prudohomme revenant de la foire ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals walking side by side. The man is on the left, with a forward-leaning posture, striding with his right foot forward. He has a round face with a mustache, wearing small circular glasses and a dark bowler hat. He is dressed in a dark suit with a light-colored shirt, dark shoes, and holds a wrapped piece of meat in his left hand. On the right is a woman with a hunched posture, small facial features, and hair pulled back or short, covered with a bonnet. She wears a voluminous, ruffled dress and holds a wrapped piece of meat. In the background, other individuals are seen in a busy market-like setting with hanging objects, possibly food items.

artworks.title: Aspect de salon le jour de l'ouverture ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a gallery looking at paintings. The individuals are dressed in top hats and seem engaged in examining the artwork on the wall. Their facial expressions are expressive, and the background shows more hanging paintings.

artworks.title: Etude de révérence pour le quadrille des lanciers
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman curtsying in an elaborate gown and an older man leaning towards her. The woman has dark hair in a bun and the man has a receding hairline. There is a mirror reflecting the woman's pose in an elegant room with woodwork details.

artworks.title: Passager ayant payé ... pour se rendre a New-York
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man sitting on the shore watching a large ship. The man is seated with his arms wrapped around his knees, gazing across the water towards a large ship in the background. The ship appears to be either partially submerged or tilted forward. The man is wearing a cap and heavy coat, and the scene is drawn with detailed pencil strokes in shades of black and grey. The style suggests a satirical or narrative scene with deep contrast and rich shading.

artworks.title: Tenez, je viens de tuer un magnifique ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men illustrated in a black and white drawing. Both men's full bodies are visible. The man on the left is standing with his body slightly turned to the right, holding up a rooster in one hand. He has a narrow, elongated face and is wearing a flat cap. He is dressed in outdoor or hunting clothes, including a coat and trousers, with a bag slung across his body and a rifle slung over his shoulder. The man on the right stands facing the left with both hands holding a rifle vertically in front of him. His face is rugged with a distinct nose, and he is also wearing a cap. He is dressed similarly in outdoor attire, featuring a jacket and trousers, and has a bag at his side. A hunting dog stands on all fours next to the man on the right, looking upward at the rooster. The background features a simple, slightly textured landscape suggesting an outdoor setting, with some abstract shapes indicating clouds or distant hills.

artworks.title: Eh! Bien, comment trouvez-vous cela?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three people are sitting at a dining table with a meal in front of them. There are two men and one woman, shown from the waist up. The men are leaning slightly forward while the woman in the center sits straight and holds a napkin up to her mouth. The man on the left has a bald spot, and the man on the right has visible hair. The woman has curly hair framing her face, with wide eyes visible above the napkin. They are dressed in dark clothing, typical of formal dining attire, with no visible jewelry. Several objects are on the table, including plates, a glass, a bottle, and cutlery. The background is a simple, textured surface without any discernible details.

artworks.title: Oui madame ... ces animaux-la ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of two figures near a railing with animals. The man is holding a top hat and leaning on the railing, while the woman in a period gown looks towards him. Behind the railing are several illustrated animals, including a goat and another animal further back. The background includes sketched trees and foliage. The style is reminiscent of a caricature or satirical illustration that may have been common in historical illustrated publications.

artworks.title: Monsieur le concierge, allant en soirée
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image features a couple standing before a doorman. The couple is elegantly dressed, with the woman wearing a heavy cloak and bonnet while the man holds a top hat and cane. They are speaking to the doorman, who is standing in a doorway. Next to the doorman's head is the word "Portier." The setting appears to be a porter's lodge in an urban Parisian building. The style resembles nineteenth-century city life artwork, focusing on social interactions. The drawing is detailed and realistically rendered with intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: Fonctionnaires ... veillant au salut de l'empire! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals sitting side by side. They are leaning slightly forward in their chairs, with different head positions. The figures have exaggerated facial features and distinct expressions, wearing hats with tassels. They are dressed in ornate, traditional clothing with wide sleeves and high collars. The room features abstract patterns in the background. Each person holds different objects, such as a fan and robes. A small item resembling a pipe is on the floor in front of them. The scene is monochromatic with emphasis on linework and shading.

artworks.title: Quelle horrible chose ... si nous avons le guerre! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two individuals are seated indoors in front of a fireplace. The person on the left sits upright with hands in their lap, while the person on the right reclines back in their chair with crossed legs. Both individuals have distinct facial features and are dressed in 19th-century clothing. The room features a fireplace with logs, ornamental items on the mantle, and two framed pictures on the wall.

artworks.title: Aspect de la salle
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a large orchestral concert with an audience and conductor. Attendees are wearing top hats and coats. The conductor is standing on a podium with arms raised, appearing to lead an orchestra. Rows of figures are visible in the background, filling a vast space that suggests an auditorium or grand hall. The style features strong lines and hatching, possibly lithographic, giving the image a textured, slightly animated quality.

artworks.title: Ma femme ..., comme nous n'aurions pas ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals at an art exhibition. The image shows several figures closely observing framed artworks on a gallery wall. The figures are depicted in period attire, and they appear captivated by the works on display. The gallery wall is densely packed with artwork, with frames stretching from floor to ceiling. Each figure's expression conveys a sense of fascination and intent study, as they point and gaze at the art before them. The drawing captures the appearance of the attendees and the atmosphere of an art exhibition from that period.

artworks.title: Le peintre qui a eu un tableau refusé ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing in an art exhibition. One man on the left is pointing at a painting, while the man on the right appears to be leaning in to speak. A woman stands behind them, looking towards the painting. In the background, shadowy figures of a crowd are visible, along with other artwork and a bustling environment.

artworks.title: Commençant a rendre justice aux blanches
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing features a figure in a pointed hat aiming a cannon at heads in the distance. The scene displays a caricatured figure in a military-style uniform holding a cannon emitting smoke, pointed towards a group of disembodied heads on the right. The illustration suggests political satire with the title "Beginning to render justice to the whites."

artworks.title: Tiens ... qu'est-ce qu'c'est donc qu'ça? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing closely together in an exhibition or gallery setting. They are positioned upright, facing a statue to the left that's partially visible. The woman on the far left has her arms folded. She has exaggerated facial features with a prominent chin and nose, and neat hair. She wears a long dress. The man in the middle has distinctive facial features, with a broad nose and strong jawline. He wears a top hat, bow tie, and a coat. The man on the right also has elongated facial features, with a profile showing. He wears a long coat and a top hat, with casual suits visible underneath. In the background, there are other figures sketched with less detail, wearing coats and top hats, suggesting a formal gathering. The setting is indoors with subtle shading and sculptures visible.

artworks.title: La chasse sur l'eau
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a small boat. The man on the left is standing, holding a rifle, while the man on the right is seated rowing. A dog is also in the boat. The background is shaded and suggests rain or mist. There are water ripples visible and reeds or tall grass surrounding the boat.

artworks.title: Les spectateurs de l'orchestre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men seated closely together in several rows, captured from the waist up. The men are sitting upright, with some leaning slightly forward. Each man has distinctive facial features with exaggerated expressions. They wear formal attire with high collars and dark jackets, and two of them are holding hats in their laps. The background reveals the interior of a theater, with rows of seats and subtle details of an ornate ceiling.

artworks.title: Monsieur Colimard si vous continuez ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a theater. The drawing depicts an interior view of a theater, focusing on an audience seated in box seats and observing a ballet performance. Two figures are prominently featured in the foreground, seated next to each other. The individual on the right is leaning forward with arms up, holding opera glasses to observe the stage more closely. On the stage, visible through the opening of the box, a ballet dancer is performing with an extended leg in mid-air, while the background suggests an audience onlookers and additional dancers. The drawing emphasizes intricate details, such as the curly hair of the figures and the folds of their clothing. The French text at the bottom implies a conversation regarding the appropriateness of the individual's gaze at the dancers. This drawing is in the style of Honoré Daumier, known for his satirical works and observations of societal behavior.

artworks.title: A la minute
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated at the top of horse-drawn carriages. The first man is on the left, looking towards the viewer with a slight smile, while the second man faces him with a serious expression. Both are wearing top hats and long overcoats, holding the reins of their respective carriages. In each carriage window, another man is visible from the shoulders up, with different expressions. The background features the carriages, horses, and some light text visible in the background.

artworks.title: Je commence a trouver ... en temps de neige! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two caricatured figures walking through snow. Both are wearing hats and carrying rifles. The figures are exaggerated and comical, with emphasized facial features. The first figure is hunched and trudging through the snow, while the second figure follows closely behind with determination. The snow is textured, creating a sense of depth. The line work and shading contribute to the humorous depiction of the winter scene.
